messages:
Alex: Heads up — repeated latency spikes on embedding+rerank pools last two weekends (EU morning). Seen tail p99 jump from ~200ms to ~900ms for small rerank requests. Need a quick weekend surge mitigation plan.

Maria: Yep saw that. Likely combo of region traffic shift + some large overnight batch jobs overlapping. I'll pull recent qps by model.

Chen: Data snapshot: Sat 03:30-05:30 UTC we had a 38% increase in embedding qps, rerank concurrency up 2.5x. GPU util on embed-pool hit 92%.

ops-bot: Alert: nodepool embed-pool-eu exhausted at 1768128000. Autoscale triggered 0 -> 3 but failed due to quota.

Lisa: Quota issue again? Which quota — GPUs or IPs?

Chen: GPU quota in eu-west1 depleted for project-redwood-prod, increase pending. For short term we can failover some low-priority work to us-central.

Sam: Two-prong plan: short-term runbook for this weekend + longer-term capacity forecast. Runbook items: 1) split embed vs rerank into separate pools, 2) shift non-urgent rerank to scheduled batch windows, 3) pre-warm nodes 45–60m before surge.

Alex: Also flip on more aggressive KV-prefix caching for rerank model variants to cut token compute.

Maria: Quick capacity calc: current weekend EU usage ~1200 GPU-hours. Forecast +40% growth -> ~1680 GPU-hours (+480). If we pre-warm 4 x A10-equivalent for 4h that's 64 GPU-hours, still need autoscale/quota for the remainder.

Chen: Cost note: at our accounting rate $2.25/GPU-hour that's ~+$1,080 per weekend if we scale fully to meet surge. Could trade off by delaying low-priority rerank to nightly batch.

Sam: On batch vs realtime — convert low-priority rerank to our job-runner. Example job label to mark low-priority:

```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: rerank-lowprio-2026-03-21
  labels:
    workload: rerank
    priority: low
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: rerank
        image: registry/redwood/rerank:prod
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```

Maria: Also propose a routing policy: requests with "top_k" <= 5 and header X-Workload: batch -> route to rerank-batch queue.

Alex: Routing snippet (gateway rule):

```
if (req.headers['x-workload'] == 'batch' || req.body.top_k <= 5) {
  route.to = 'rerank-batch'
} else {
  route.to = 'rerank-realtime'
}
```

Lisa: One constraint: cross-region egress if we move a chunk to us-central -> higher egress costs and added latency for EU users. Need egress estimate before we shift majority of load.

Chen: I'll run a 6-hour queuing simulation with pre-warm + 10% headroom and post modeled p50/p95/p99 and GPU-hours by EOD.

Alex: OK action items: Chen run sim and post numbers by EOD, Maria open PR for routing rule + add label to job-runner, Sam draft weekend runbook + prewarm playbook, Lisa confirm quota change ETA with cloud support, ops-bot schedule prewarm job at T-60m. :thumbsup:

Maria: If quota takes >24h, fallback is split-weight routing to us and reduce embed batch concurrency. I'll sketch that in the PR.

Sam: Agree. If anyone hits blockers ping me and I'll escalate quota with infra sales engineer.

Alex: Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC for final signoff.
